name: [Provenex] Tool-call deny burst per caller
message:
Provenex denied more than 20 tool calls from a single caller in the last 30 minutes.

This pattern is one of three things:
  1. A misconfigured agent calling the wrong tool / requesting out-of-jurisdiction data.
  2. A compromised caller probing the policy.
  3. A legitimate spike (data import, batch job) the policy is not yet aware of.

First response:
  1. Pull caller_hash {{@usr.id}}; the privacy-preserving identifier is enough for the SOC to correlate with internal directory if you hold the salt.
  2. Check the receipts' policy.tool_call_control.decisions[].rules_fired to see which rule denied.
  3. If legitimate, update the policy. If not, investigate the caller.

Fires when a single caller_hash exceeds 20 denials in any 30-minute window. Suppression: 1h per caller.
